cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Hand me the drawer key before I sign the club accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. My signature covers the receipts too. Let me check how it adds up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put mine beside yours. Give me the key and we'll correct it together before either name goes outside this room.

mechanism: A insists on receipt-level verification and supervises a joint correction to persuade B to surrender the key.
confusable: Being bossy about access is not enough; S03 must explain why B's proposed total check is inadequate.
comparison: An anxious club treasurer's responsibility differs from the privacy dispute over a note.
seedUse: Use receipt-drawer key, matching totals and shared correction as a means of gaining access.
